title: Record the native value of dirty helper L359
body:
## Summary
- The native dirty-fault receipt sets `L359` to `T` times the unit constant payload, and its literal check uses `T = 256`.
- With unit `1/1048576`, the stored maximum data error `1/1024` equals `4 u T` and the stored injection `1/512` equals `8 u T`.
- No selected frontier change and no new exponent. The 512 components and the 1,004 frame vectors are not reconstructed.
